title: Hypnotic
summary: HYPNOT'IC, adjective [Gr. sleep.] Having the quality of producing sleep; tending to produce sleep; narcotic; soporific. HYPNOT'IC, noun A medicine that produces, or tends to produce sleep; an opiate;
